scope: Only Batch B masters, runtime images, prompt sidecars and this batch JSON written. No code/UI, Git, production, main manifest or test-file changes.
limitations: Rank overlays use genuine native alpha preserved without masking, keying, or alpha synthesis, but generated low-alpha residue and small edge fringes mean the literal all-zero x15%-85% / y15%-90% zone test fails. Inspect per-asset alpha metrics; needs_parent_review.

Rank-10 runtime alone uses a vertical source crop (top 110, height 580 of 793) and fit:fill resize to put inset rails near canvas edges. Its original master is uncropped; endcap tips are cropped in runtime.

Base banners have light text-zone mean luma 225.6-239.7/255, with 2.7%-7.9% of the full requested rectangle below luma180 at edge ornament intrusions, strongest on Cinder. 480-wide previews visually checked.
No human visual approval or parent gate score recorded; all assets unscored.
